_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 5% break rate over 7 days makes HOLD the statistically honest default, and neither brain has identified a confirmed breaker present in the live data right now.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward-calls Disbelief while narrative stays in Denial; I side with the analyst's current-phase call (Denial) but reject its forward jump to Disbelief as premature without a confirmed breaker.
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed holds 20-30, btc_momentum holds 45-55, and score remains in Denial band for next 2-3 windows
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows collapse below 70 OR VIX spikes above 22 with funding above 60 — would signal risk-off acceleration to Anxiety/Panic
